headline: US Strategic Bombers Deploy as Iran Declares Hormuz Closed
subheadline: B-1s and B-52s launch from RAF Fairford while Theodore Roosevelt begins seven-month deployment; Iran claims US warships fled.
lede: US B-1 and B-52 strategic bombers launched from RAF Fairford for Middle East operations as two fighter squadrons deployed to Israel's Ovda airbase and the USS Theodore Roosevelt began a seven-month deployment from San Diego. Iran's Rear Admiral Sayyari declared the Strait of Hormuz closed, stating US warships fled to the southern Indian Ocean, while an Iranian MP made the waterway the core of negotiations. In Ukraine, the Third Army Corps completed the 'Vivyaldi' operation, recapturing 51 square kilometers including Nove, Riddkub, and Katerynivka with 2,000 Russian casualties and 250 prisoners taken. Russian drone and missile strikes simultaneously targeted Kyiv, Chernihiv, and Kharkiv, with Moscow claiming destruction of a Ukrainian telecommunications center.

sections.title: Vivyaldi Operation Recaptures 51km², Captures 250 Russians
sections.body: Ukraine's Third Army Corps concluded the third season of the 'Vivyaldi' operation, retaking Nove, Riddkub, and Katerynivka while restoring control over Karpivka and Novomikhailivka. The offensive yielded 51 square kilometers of recovered territory, bringing total gains to 176 square kilometers since offensive operations began. Ukrainian forces reported 2,000 Russian casualties and captured over 250 Russian soldiers as prisoners of war. Simultaneously, Russian drones and missiles struck Kyiv, Chernihiv, and Kharkiv, with Moscow claiming destruction of the Ukrtelkom telecommunications center in Kyiv.

sections.title: US Bombers Deploy; Iran Declares Hormuz Closed
sections.body: US B-1 and B-52 strategic bombers launched from RAF Fairford for Middle East operations while two fighter squadrons deployed to Israel's Ovda airbase. The USS Theodore Roosevelt departed San Diego for a deployment expected to exceed seven months. Iran's Rear Admiral Sayyari declared the Strait of Hormuz closed and asserted US warships had fled to the southern Indian Ocean. Iranian MP Abbas Moghtadaei stated the strait is now the core of negotiations and warned resistance will continue if Washington rejects Tehran's conditions.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous deployment of US strategic bombers, a carrier strike group, and fighter squadrons to Israel signals preparation for potential large-scale operations against Iranian assets. Iran's declaration closing the Strait of Hormuz and framing it as a negotiation lever indicates a strategy of maritime coercion and deterrence. Ukrainian operational success in the Vivyaldi offensive contrasts with Russia's continued mobilization to 2.44 million personnel and persistent multi-axis drone attacks on critical infrastructure.
